summary: A cache invalidation fix in one repo that updates the batch inventory location levels mutation to clear the query cache after a successful update, ensuring the UI reflects the new quantity immediately.

steps.why: Turn the ticket into a testable inline story with clear Given/When/Then and tech notes for the cache invalidation pattern.
steps.instructions: Focus on the cache invalidation mechanism: which query key to invalidate, when to trigger it (after mutation success), and the existing cache patterns in the codebase.

steps.why: Human approval of specs and this plan before Dev.
